dispatcher_model.registry_location: L4780-L4800 (21 lines, 18 entries; 17 unique formatter names + 1 alias check_url -> _fmt_check_http_service)
dispatcher_model.dispatcher_resolution: name = _TOOL_FORMATTERS.get(tool_name); fn = getattr(cls, name, None); return fn(out) if fn else default
dispatcher_model.critical_constraint: getattr(cls, name) MUST resolve to a callable that accepts (out) — i.e. a classmethod-style descriptor whose __get__ binds correctly when invoked as fn(out).

rationale_for_not_moving_dispatcher: _format_tool_result resolves names against cls via getattr; moving formatters but keeping dispatcher in BrainSession ensures the existing dispatcher invariant is preserved unchanged (shims are still bound to cls).

Extracting dispatcher would require either: (a) moving registry+resolver to new module and adding a re-export back, OR (b) passing cls/registry across module boundary. Both increase blast radius unnecessarily for B7-06.
Defer dispatcher to a follow-up B7-07 once C1 is validated.

candidate_A.reason: fmt_x signature is (out) — classmethod(fmt_x) would inject cls as first arg, making fmt_x receive cls=out and fail. Not viable without an adapter wrapper.

candidate_B.drawback: lambdas hurt traceback readability; 17 lines but opaque debugging.

advantages: Preserves getattr(cls, name) semantics: descriptor resolves to a bound method with arity (out,).
Trivial to delete in a future cleanup once direct callers migrate.

compatibility_test_required: Invoke BrainSession._format_tool_result(tool_name, mock_result) for each of the 18 _TOOL_FORMATTERS keys (17 names + alias `check_url`) and assert the dispatcher still resolves through shims via getattr(cls, _TOOL_FORMATTERS[tool_name]).
Assert each shim `getattr(BrainSession, '_fmt_<name>')` is callable AND classmethod-bound.
Assert each module-level `fmt_<name>(out)` returns the same string as `BrainSession._fmt_<name>(out)` for representative `out` payloads.
